pages.text: $(thing)Lumen Grazer$() — peaceful herd grazer.$(br)$(thing)Shade Stalker$() — fast dark predator that flees light.$(br)$(thing)Lantern Beetle$() — glowing flyer; bottle it for a lamp.$(br)$(thing)Sporeling$() — jungle/cave swarm; bursts a spore cloud.$(br)$(thing)Mirelurker$() — Moonmire ambusher.

$(thing)Lumen Fish$() — schooling glow-fish (bucketable).$(br)$(thing)Sky Jelly$() — harmless air drifter.$(br)$(thing)Glowmoth$() — flower guardian; turns hostile if you break a bloom near it.$(br)$(thing)Rootback$() — huge, slow, tanky turtle.$(br)$(thing)Crag Wraith$() — flying crags hunter.$(br)$(thing)Echo Sentinel$() — ruin guardian (see The Lumenwrights).
